name: The Public Domain Review
description: Curious art, illustrations and stories from historical collections.
optional_activity_prompt: Browse a collection, choose one detail and use it as a starting point for a sketch.
rights_note: Historic collection items and the site’s own essays can have different rights. Do not treat the entire site as copyright-free.

name: Closer to Van Eyck
description: Explore paintings in close detail through a specialist conservation project.
optional_activity_prompt: Choose a small area of a painting and notice how color, edges and texture are used.
rights_note: Public viewing does not grant permission to reproduce conservation imagery.

name: Smithsonian 3D
description: Explore digitized objects through an interactive 3D collection.
optional_activity_prompt: Rotate an object and draw it from more than one viewpoint.
rights_note: Some Smithsonian assets have open-access designations; verify the individual asset before reusing it.

name: Obelisk Art History
description: Artist biographies, movements and works to explore by interest.
optional_activity_prompt: Choose one artist and compare how they handled the same subject in different works.
rights_note: Link to the project. Do not assume its writing or images are free to republish.

name: Europeana
description: Cultural collections from museums, libraries and archives across Europe.
optional_activity_prompt: Explore one theme across several collections and save links to the sources you like.
rights_note: Rights differ between items and supplying institutions; an aggregator listing is not a reuse license.

name: Biodiversity Heritage Library
description: Digitized natural-history books and detailed botanical and animal illustrations.
optional_activity_prompt: Choose a botanical plate and study its shapes before drawing a plant of your own.
rights_note: Historic pages can have different copyright statuses by item and jurisdiction. Link-only in this shortlist.

name: Standard Ebooks
description: Carefully formatted editions of classic books to browse by author and subject.
optional_activity_prompt: Choose an opening chapter, read a little and decide whether you want to continue.
rights_note: Public-domain status can differ by country. Do not import books or covers into Soosh based on this listing.

name: Poetry Foundation
description: Poems, poet profiles and introductions to different ways of writing.
optional_activity_prompt: Read a poem, then write a few original lines about an ordinary object.
rights_note: Many poems are copyrighted and displayed with permission. Link to them rather than copying them.

name: The Marginalian
description: Essays connecting books, art, science and creative lives.
optional_activity_prompt: Follow one essay to a book or artist you want to explore further.
rights_note: The essays and illustrations are not automatically licensed for republication.

name: Chrome Music Lab
description: Browser experiments for exploring rhythm, melody and sound.
optional_activity_prompt: Try a short rhythm and then attempt to play a version on your instrument.
rights_note: Link to the interactive tools. Do not copy their code, branding or recordings without checking applicable terms.

name: musictheory.net
description: Music-theory explanations and exercises for learning the basics.
optional_activity_prompt: Choose one concept you are learning and try it on your instrument afterward.
rights_note: The educational material remains subject to the site’s terms. Listing a link is not a reuse permission.

name: Exploratorium Science Snacks
description: Hands-on science activities with explanations, materials and steps.
optional_activity_prompt: Choose a relevant light or color activity and read its instructions and requirements before starting.
rights_note: Use an outbound link. Do not copy the activity instructions, diagrams or photos into Soosh without permission or an applicable license.

name: Miniature Engineering Craftsmanship Museum
description: Miniature machines, models and examples of detailed craftsmanship.
optional_activity_prompt: Choose an object and study how its maker joined small parts or represented details.
rights_note: Museum and maker images may be copyrighted. Link to the museum rather than republishing them.

name: Plants of the World Online
description: Kew’s reference for plant names, distributions and botanical information.
optional_activity_prompt: Check a plant’s accepted name before looking for a care guide suited to your conditions.
rights_note: A botanical reference is not a universal plant-care guide. Text, images and data may have different terms.

name: Macaulay Library
description: Animal sounds, photographs and video from a scientific media archive.
optional_activity_prompt: Explore a species you recognize and listen for differences between recordings.
rights_note: Recordings and images can belong to contributors. Do not download and rehost them based on this listing.

name: Old Maps Online
description: Find historical maps and follow links to the collections that hold them.
optional_activity_prompt: Compare an old map with a place you know before deciding on a suitable present-day route.
rights_note: The map provider controls image rights. Old maps do not verify current access, routes or venue availability.
